name: H3-LongVideos
description: ComfyUI custom node: one prompt into a chain of MiniMax-H3 video+audio shots, joined into one continuous video.
_note: Present so the Hugging Face Hub can count downloads. The Hub uses a set of query files to avoid double-counting, and with no library declared it looks for config.json; a repo without one is never counted, which is why this repo read 0 downloads. See https://huggingface.co/docs/hub/models-download-stats. Nothing in the node reads this file.
